findings: ROOT CAUSE of the drowned road is NOT A* routing through a lake. The natural terrain at (2187,2215) is DRY LAND at 154.01 m. The road's own elevation profile in build-roads.mjs is 69.17 m there -- an 85 m CUTTING that _applyRoads carves into the hill, which then fills with water (surface 135.30). waterSurfaceAt returns null before setRoads and 135.3 after. Same at helstrom-gideon (1652,2754): natural 48.65 m dry, roaded 33.34 m, depth 7.63 m.

The cause is MAX_GRADE=0.12 in build-roads.mjs: the forward/backward grade clamps slice the profile off any hill the road cannot climb at 12%, and _applyRoads then blends ground DOWN to the deck. There is no cut/fill limit at all.
The critic's remedy (depth-cost the A*) would not have fixed it: depthG is sampled pre-road and is 0 there.
Corpus imposes NO grade constraint on roads; MAX_GRADE=0.12 is the builder's invention. Fixing cut/fill should also raise M36-ROAD-RELIEF (26.7% vs 30%) for free.
The Weeping Ford minor settlement (2129.5,2206.5) is a mandatory waypoint 58 m from the deepest point.
Static road-water audit reproduces the verdict: LOW stormhold-helstrom max 66.135 m / W5 500 m (verdict: 65.64 / 502 at 12 m point spacing; I subsample to 3 m).

ROAD FIX LANDED. M2-ROAD-ABOVE-WATER PASSES: 0 m of non-tideway trunk road at W3+ at any of RISING/HIGH/FALLING/LOW. Was 512.5 m over-knee / 500 m over-chest / max 66.135 m on stormhold-helstrom at every phase. Tideway keeps 0.901 m LOW / 1.443 m HIGH. Max cut now 3.0 m (was 90.7 m), max fill 16.0 m (was 87.7 m). Crossing 6889.6 m / 57.41 min (band 52-65 min / 6300-7600 m).

Residual: 48 m of stormhold-helstrom has >100% grade because the water model produces HANGING water bodies -- narrow channels whose surface stands metres above their own banks (e.g. surface 248.3 m within 3 m of ground at 235.7 m). The deck must climb over them. Filed as a corpus defect, not fixed here.

SECOND ROOT CAUSE, not named by the critic: the water band retraction in Engine._settleWorld wrote to sim.player.pos, which combat-bridge.mirror() overwrites from combat.player.pos at the top of every step. The retraction therefore produced a constant positional LAG of v(1-mult)/mult and a STEADY-STATE SPEED OF EXACTLY v. That is why the verdict measured 1.9988 m/s in W2 SUCK and scored RI-WLD10 40/100 "completely inert". Writing the controller closes it.

MEASURED after the fix: W0 2.0000, W2 1.7000, W3 1.3000 (RI-WLD10 M49 requires exactly 1.30), W4 0.8600, W5 1.1000 m/s at steady state on sustained-band ground. W1 has no sustained patch in the province; recorded as not-found rather than faked.
